comment: Stored EARLY-FAILURE SHAPES for the offline replay harness in
tests/test_early_failure_replay.py. Each case is a canned provider script:
an ordered list of replies the fake OpenAI client hands back, in the order
Stage 0, Stage 1 and any repair draw ask for them.
These are SHAPES, not transcripts. The two legs lost in runs/2026-07-28_0919
wrote no artifacts at all -- both manifest rows carry files: [] and only
RESULT.txt exists on disk -- so there is no recorded reply to copy, which is
precisely the hole this whole change closes. What is reproduced is the
structure of each failure and the source text is a three-sentence paragraph
rather than the 50,377- and 61,997-character bodies those legs carried,
because a fixture that embeds a real paper costs megabytes and still would
'recovers' is the deliverable question: does the pipeline get a usable
pathway out of this shape, or does it report a clear incomplete outcome? Both
answers are correct results. What is never correct is a fabricated reaction,
which is why every case also asserts the reaction count.

cases.title: An empty 200 from Stage 0, then the reply that was always there

observed_in.note: the same paper extracted 3 reactions the previous day and its research leg passed in the same run, so the emptiness was transient rather than a property of the paper

cases.why_it_matters: The shape the 2026-07-28 client fix was written for. It must still recover, and the run must now be able to say it cost two draws.
cases.source_text: Glutathione is synthesized from glutamate, cysteine and glycine. Glutamate-cysteine ligase joins L-glutamate and L-cysteine to form gamma-glutamylcysteine using ATP. Glutathione synthetase then joins gamma-glutamylcysteine and glycine to form glutathione.

replies.content: {"entities": {"compounds": [{"name": "L-glutamate"}, {"name": "L-cysteine"}, {"name": "gamma-glutamylcysteine"}], "proteins": [{"name": "glutamate-cysteine ligase"}]}, "processes": {"reactions": [{"name": "gamma-glutamylcysteine synthesis", "inputs": ["L-glutamate", "L-cysteine"], "outputs": ["gamma-glutamylcysteine"], "enzymes": [{"name": "glutamate-cysteine ligase"}], "evidence": "Glutamate-cysteine ligase joins L-glutamate and L-cysteine to form gamma-glutamylcysteine using ATP."}]}}

cases.title: A moderation stop at Stage 0 spends exactly one draw

observed_in.note: not attributable to a specific leg: finish_reason was recorded nowhere in that run, which is why the postmortem could not tell a moderation stop from a provider hiccup

cases.why_it_matters: Moderation is deterministic in the prompt, so the pre-2026-07-29 loop burned LLM_MAX_RETRIES draws to arrive at the identical empty string. The budget must not be spent, and the reason must be durable enough to reach stage0_attempts.json.
cases.source_text: Glutathione is synthesized from glutamate, cysteine and glycine. Glutamate-cysteine ligase joins L-glutamate and L-cysteine to form gamma-glutamylcysteine using ATP. Glutathione synthetase then joins gamma-glutamylcysteine and glycine to form glutathione.

replies.content: {"entities": {"compounds": [{"name": "gamma-glutamylcysteine"}, {"name": "glycine"}, {"name": "glutathione"}], "proteins": [{"name": "glutathione synthetase"}]}, "processes": {"reactions": [{"name": "glutathione synthesis", "inputs": ["gamma-glutamylcysteine", "glycine"], "outputs": ["glutathione"], "enzymes": [{"name": "glutathione synthetase"}], "evidence": "Glutathione synthetase then joins gamma-glutamylcysteine and glycine to form glutathione."}]}}

cases.title: One missing comma inside processes, repaired without re-extraction

observed_in.note: shape reconstructed from _extract_json_from_text's prefix-scan behaviour, which is measurable today: this exact body salvages to entities ONLY

cases.why_it_matters: The free prefix salvage returns the entities that precede the syntax error and silently drops every reaction after it, so a one-character fault becomes 'Payload must include a processes object' three stages later. Localized repair must recover the reaction, and must not re-run the extraction to do it.
repair_note: The third reply is the second reply with ONE comma added and nothing else.
That is not cosmetic fidelity in the fixture -- it is what the content guard
in json_repair_preserves_content requires. An earlier version of this case
had the repair also add an 'evidence' field, which reads as harmless and is
exactly the behaviour the guard now refuses: a syntax repairer that can add
a field can add a reaction. A repair that invents anything falls back to
deterministic salvage instead, which is the adversarial case in
cases.source_text: Glutamate-cysteine ligase joins L-glutamate and L-cysteine to form gamma-glutamylcysteine using ATP.

cases.title: A well-formed reply that declares no processes at all

observed_in.note: the terminal message of both lost legs -- 'Payload must include a processes object' -- with one of its five possible causes

cases.why_it_matters: This is a prompt/scope failure, not a cleaning failure and not a parse failure. It must be reported as its own category and must NOT be padded with an invented reaction to satisfy processes_required.
cases.source_text: Glutathione is an abundant low-molecular-weight thiol antioxidant found in plants, mammals and microbes.

cases.title: Three reactions returned, three reactions discarded, none survive

observed_in.note: the SAME terminal message as the case above, from the opposite cause -- which is exactly why they were indistinguishable

cases.why_it_matters: The model did its job. Every row was removed by a cleaning rule, and before cleaning_report.json existed nothing downstream could tell this apart from the zero-processes case above. The reasons must name the rules.
cases.source_text: Glutamate-cysteine ligase joins L-glutamate and L-cysteine to form gamma-glutamylcysteine. Glutathione synthetase then forms glutathione. Glutathione is oxidized to GSSG.

expect.incomplete_contains: cleaning discarded every one of the 3 process row(s)

cases.title: Correct reactions whose participants were never declared as entities

observed_in.note: the silent loss: this payload passes the post-extraction contract and loses its reactions later, in filter_unresolvable_reactions, where a removal surfaces only as a log line

cases.why_it_matters: The biology is right and the bookkeeping is short. Deterministic reconstruction must recover the registry rows as UNRESOLVED shells -- carrying no identifier and no function -- rather than the pipeline deleting evidenced reactions for a missing row.
